pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Leaves an Echo — a return point — and for 5 seconds a mint smoke hangs over it, a gateway between dimensions.$(br2)$(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() Path level 3.

pages.title: Use and limits
pages.text: When you disable the ability, you return to your previous location and the smoke disappears. While the smoke is there you can use a Proof of Strength on it (Herald of Death). To enter the Beyond, right-click the smoke while carrying a $(l:resources/beyond/crystal_soul)Crystallized Soul$(/l) or after earning the “King of the Beyond” advancement.

Dimension wheel. In the passive ability wheel (T), right-click Echo of Death: a wheel opens with the dimensions you have already visited (Overworld, Nether, End, the Beyond or a dimension from another mod). Choosing one takes you to where you last stood in that dimension, or to a safe spot nearby if there is none. The ability uses the shared ability cooldown.

pages.title: Several Echoes
pages.text: In the upgrade window (the Spirit Form section) you can buy extra Echo slots: the N-th costs N levels, the first is free. With several Echoes, activating the ability opens a wheel: LMB on an Echo returns to it, the "New Echo" sector leaves another, and Shift+RMB renames one. The tooltip shows coordinates and dimension.
